sentences.text: `` Umbrella '' is a song by Barbadian singer Rihanna from her third studio album Good Girl Gone Bad -LRB- 2007 -RRB- .	Rihanna	Rihanna	Good Girl Gone Bad	Good Girl Gone Bad

It features American rapper Jay Z , who co-wrote the song with its producers Tricky Stewart and Kuk Harrell , with additional writing from The-Dream .	Jay Z	Jay Z	Kuk Harrell	Kuk Harrell	Tricky Stewart	Tricky Stewart	The-Dream	The-Dream
The song was originally written with Britney Spears in mind , but her label rejected it .	Britney Spears	Britney Spears

`` Umbrella '' is a pop and R&B song with hip-hop and rock touches referring to a romantic and platonic relationship and the strength of that relationship .	R&B	Contemporary R&B	pop	Pop music	hip-hop	Hip hop music	rock	Rock n' roll

Entertainment Weekly ranked the song number one on the 10 Best Singles of 2007 , while Rolling Stone and Time listed the song at number three on the 100 Best Songs of 2007 .	Entertainment Weekly	Entertainment Weekly	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone	Time	Time (magazine)
The song has earned Rihanna several awards and nominations .	Rihanna	Rihanna
In 2007 , the song won two awards at the MTV Video Music Awards , when it was nominated for four .	MTV Video Music Awards	2007 MTV Video Music Awards

At the 2008 Grammy Awards , `` Umbrella '' also earned Rihanna and Jay Z a Grammy Award for Best Rap/Sung Collaboration in addition to receiving nominations for Record of the Year and Song of the Year . `` Umbrella '' was a commercial success , topping the charts in Australia , Canada , Germany , Spain , the Republic of Ireland , Sweden , Switzerland , the United Kingdom , and the United States .

In the United Kingdom , where the song 's chart performance generated controversy when the country was experiencing excessive flooding and large amounts of rain at the time , it was one of the most played songs on radio in the 2000s -LRB- decade -RRB- .	excessive flooding and large amounts of rain	2007 United Kingdom floods	radio	radio
